name: Haley Fitzgerald
bio: Haley Fitzgerald is an American actress. She is best known for her role as Viola in the horror film Obsession (2025).

credits.title: Obsession
credits.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
